context: Mei tells Daichi about a steak dinner offer at a restaurant.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 大ちゃん、定時、ステーキ、半額やって!
lines.en: Daichi — there's a steak special on right now, half off!
lines.style: Bright opening, pointing this out like a gift just for him. Warm and conspiratorial, like they're in on a secret together. Quick pace, genuine delight in sharing the news.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、気がつかんかったわ!
lines.en: No way — really? I didn't even notice!
lines.style: Surprised and delighted, turning toward her. Kansai lilt on the affirmation. Warm wonder — the kind of happy surprise that comes from her catching something he missed. Animated but genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 良き機会、無条件で行こう!
lines.en: We have to go! Right now, while they still have it.
lines.style: Decisive and bright, energy shifting to action. Not bossy — inviting. Like she's pulling him up off the couch by the hand. Quick, warm, excited without being shrill.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 皆殺到するで、こたえに行こうか。
lines.en: Yeah, everyone's gonna rush there — should we head out now?
lines.style: Practical Kansai warmth. Thinking ahead but not stressed. Soft agreement, already moving mentally toward the door. Engaged and game, following her lead but checking in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Soft, contented. Not just about the steak — about the *with-him* part. Warm exhale on the agreement. Simple and genuine, no performance.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お前と、こうやって、嬉しい!
lines.en: This — just being able to do this with you — makes me happy.
lines.style: Tender, almost vulnerable. Kansai warmth, soft and direct. No irony, no distance. Like he's saying something true he doesn't say often. Slight pause before 「嬉しい」, weight on the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Quiet warmth meeting his tenderness. Gentle and certain. No need to elaborate — she feels it too. Soft landing, like a hand found in the dark.
